title: Used to, was going to, should have
summary: Look back at how things used to be (*Eskiden burada otururduk*), at plans that fell through (*Seni arayacaktım*), and at what should or could have happened (*Gelmeliydin*, *Arayabilirdin*); say what is about to happen with *-mAk üzere*.
canDo: Describe what you used to do and how a place used to be
Explain a plan that didn't work out
Say what someone should or could have done, and what you couldn't have done
Say that something is about to happen
